question: Rohan starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Rohan starts from point A and drives 8 km towards the north.

He then takes a left turn, drives 12 km, turns left and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 14 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 3 km and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d24c951d8a3701c1cd48a359bd970691eb5d183acb280985c8ad8931edd3e28.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78ec33c04f878f2319a0a913893235a0ce3cd0fec01b11dac9a6032ee3fd433c.png] 

Thus, Rohan has to drive 2km west to reach point A. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
